objects.name: Analytic 2095
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies python/python3 execution by unexpected users/services, from unapproved script paths, or from cron/systemd contexts not associated with documented automation, particularly when followed by OT communications, sensitive file access, persistence, or child-shell activity. Alert only when the interpreter/shell is not expected for the asset role or user/service context, or when its parent, path, arguments, remote-session source, or follow-on behavior violates the approved OT baseline. Suppress approved engineering scripts, vendor support, diagnostics, backup, patching, and maintenance windows.
